outputs.L3:
The tube rack for a centrifugal separator is designed to allow the bottom rubber portion to be easily mounted and replaced when necessary. This improves maintenance convenience and makes it possible to exchange the rubber portion without replacing the entire rack.

At the same time, the bottom rubber portion is configured so that, once it has been installed, it is not easily separated from the rack during use. This helps ensure stable operation during centrifugation and prevents accidental detachment caused by vibration, rotation, or handling.

The tube rack includes a holder provided with a plurality of tube holes. These tube holes are configured to receive and support sample tubes. Each tube hole has an opening on the tube insertion side, through which a sample tube is inserted, and another opening at the bottom side of the holder.

The rack further includes a cylindrical base having a bottom portion. This base is configured to detachably hold both the holder and the bottom rubber portion. The cylindrical base is also shaped and sized to fit into a bucket of a centrifugal separator. As a result, the tube rack can securely accommodate sample tubes while allowing easy assembly, replacement of the bottom rubber portion, and stable placement in the centrifugal separator bucket.
outputs.L4:
A centrifugal separator tube rack is configured to securely hold sample tubes during centrifugal separation while also allowing convenient maintenance of the rack components. The rack includes a holder provided with a plurality of tube holes into which sample tubes can be inserted, a detachable cylindrical base mounted to the holder, and a bottom rubber portion arranged at the lower side of the rack. The bottom rubber portion includes rubber members positioned so that they correspond to the tube holes of the holder. When the rack is assembled, these rubber members fit into the respective tube holes and support the lower ends of the sample tubes.

The holder, the cylindrical base, and the bottom rubber portion are connected by connecting pieces or engagement portions that allow the components to be assembled and disassembled as needed. Because the cylindrical base is detachable, the bottom rubber portion can be mounted to or removed from the rack without requiring complicated tools or procedures. This makes it easy to replace the rubber portion when it becomes worn, damaged, contaminated, or deteriorated through repeated use.

At the same time, the connecting structure prevents the bottom rubber portion from becoming unintentionally separated from the holder during handling, transport, or centrifugal operation. The rubber members remain properly aligned with the tube holes, ensuring stable support of the sample tubes and reducing the risk of misplacement or detachment. As a result, the tube rack provides improved reliability during use, while also simplifying inspection, cleaning, and replacement of consumable or wear-prone parts.

Overall, this centrifugal separator tube rack offers a practical structure in which the bottom rubber portion can be easily attached and replaced, yet remains securely held in place during normal operation. This improves the maintainability, durability, and safety of the rack, and helps ensure consistent performance in laboratories and other environments where centrifugal separation of samples is performed.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract for a centrifuge tube rack invention with a holder (14), tube holes (12), bottom rubber portion (15), bottom rubber members (25), connecting pieces (24), and a cylindrical base (13).
counterfactuals.output: A centrifuge tube rack includes a holder (14) having a plurality of tube holes (12) configured to receive and support centrifuge tubes. A cylindrical base (13) is coupled to a lower portion of the holder (14) to provide stable support for the rack. A bottom rubber portion (15) is disposed at the underside of the cylindrical base (13) and includes a plurality of bottom rubber members (25) arranged to contact a supporting surface. The bottom rubber members (25) are connected to one another by connecting pieces (24), thereby forming an integrated cushioning and anti-slip structure. The bottom rubber portion (15) absorbs vibration, reduces sliding during handling or centrifuge-tube loading, and improves stability of the centrifuge tube rack on a work surface.

counterfactuals.prompt: Summarize the following invention in formal patent language: a tube rack for a centrifugal separator where the bottom rubber part is easy to mount and replace but does not detach easily during use.
counterfactuals.output:
A tube rack for a centrifugal separator is provided, comprising a rack body configured to hold one or more sample tubes and a bottom elastic member disposed at a lower portion of the rack body for supporting or cushioning the tubes. The bottom elastic member is formed of rubber or another resilient material and is configured to be detachably mounted to the rack body by an engagement structure that permits easy installation and replacement while resisting unintended separation during centrifugal operation.

In one embodiment, the engagement structure includes complementary retaining portions provided on the rack body and the bottom elastic member, such as projections, recesses, grooves, lips, hooks, undercuts, or snap-fit portions. The retaining portions allow the bottom elastic member to be pressed, slid, or fitted into a mounted position and mechanically retained against forces generated during use of the centrifugal separator. The bottom elastic member may further include an elastic deformation portion that facilitates mounting and removal by manual operation while maintaining a secure attachment when the tube rack is subjected to vibration, impact, or centrifugal force.

Accordingly, the tube rack enables the bottom rubber part to be readily attached and replaced for maintenance, cleaning, or wear compensation, while preventing accidental detachment during normal centrifugal separation.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a concise technical description of a centrifuge separator tube rack including a detachable holder, replaceable bottom rubber members connected by pieces, and a cylindrical bottomed base insertable into a bucket.
counterfactuals.output: A centrifuge separator tube rack includes a detachable tube holder and a cylindrical bottomed base configured for insertion into a centrifuge bucket. The holder supports a plurality of separator tubes and is removably mounted to the base. Replaceable bottom rubber members are arranged at the lower tube-supporting positions to cushion and position the tube bottoms, with adjacent rubber members connected by connecting pieces to facilitate collective handling, installation, and replacement. The bottomed base provides structural support and stable seating within the bucket during centrifugation.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3
